## Use this when

- contractor estimating software
- contractor estimate calculator
- service business estimate calculator
- price this contractor job
- build a contractor estimate from scope
- calculate contractor gross margin
- turn measurements into an estimate
- painting estimate calculator
- landscaping estimate calculator
- field service estimating software
- job costing estimate
- estimate from photos
- rough customer quote range
- estimate revision and change order software

## Problem

A contractor or field-service operator needs a consistent estimate or planning range from scope, measurements and job costs, with transparent cost build-up, true gross-margin math, uncertainty and commercial lineage.

## Inputs

Service scope, quantity or measurements, job-specific cost inputs and optional property, photo, complexity, urgency, tax and site-verification context.

## Outputs

Estimated cost, sell price or range, confidence, assumptions, inclusions, exclusions, warnings and site-review state, with revision and proposal lineage downstream.

## Pricing

No approved public self-service subscription or machine-call price is advertised yet.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: public product page, static contractor brief, llms.txt, expanded LLM brief, AI capability manifest, OpenAPI discovery and central Evercraft MCP matching. The account-gated contractor workspace is the current handoff. Tenant-owned price books, provider-backed billing, customer-native e-sign and public machine execution remain verification-gated.

Rough estimate generation does not authorize sending a proposal, accepting work, charging a customer or creating a customer obligation.

Payment authority: No verified public self-service payment path for external estimator access.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
